name: Zhejiang Zhengguang Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Zhengguang Industrial Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of ion exchange and adsorption resins in China, Germany, Switzerland, Russia, Italy, South Korea, the United States, Africa, and internationally. The company's products include general, dual and floating bed, mixed bed, acrylic acid, chelation, hydrometallurgical, catalyst, decolorizing, indicator, powdered, and uniform particle size resins; and potable water treatment, chromatographic media, and other products, as well as resins for the sweetener industry.
